name: Aniyome Kyouka-san to Sono Haha Chikako-san ~Bijin Tsuma to Bijukubo to Issho~
original_name: 兄嫁京香さんとその母千佳子さん～美人妻と美熟母といっしょ～
source: Protag gets invited by his sister in-law and his older bother who is 10 years older than him,  to stay with them instead of living alone in an university boarding house. Also staying with them are both his Mother and Father in-law.  Peaceful and Happy days ensue until certain things are revealed about his brother. How will this affect his relation with the two ladies in the house ?
translation: Protag受到他的嫂子和比他大10岁的哥哥的邀请，和他们住在一起，而不是独自住在大学宿舍里。和他们住在一起的还有他的岳母和岳父。平静而快乐的日子随之而来，直到有关他兄弟的某些事情被揭露。这会对他和屋里两位女士的关系产生怎样的影响？
